{
  "edges": [
    {
      "fromKey": "n-opw2ln",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "The area directory (IA-D01) establishes that the Utilities air gallery serves RHOB and distributes instrument air to header H-R. Personnel U-A/U-B held current qualifications at shift start, implying they were authorized to operate within this served area.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the gallery did not serve RHOB or distribute air to H-R, U-A/U-B's qualifications would be irrelevant to this specific hazard.",
      "competingExplanation": "None identified; area scope and personnel qualification are independent facts supporting operational authority within that zone.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. Both premises are supported by distinct records."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1myxjth",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "Upstream pressure P-U remained stable at 6.9 bar, indicating the source and main distribution routes were functional when U-A/U-B began work.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If upstream pressure had dropped, the interruption would have been a source failure rather than an isolated distribution issue.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; stable upstream pressure supports the hypothesis of a localized or downstream event.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. Upstream stability is recorded."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1cs3s92",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "Desk entries do not log every field operation or identify the point of interruption, creating a gap in situational awareness for U-A/U-B regarding valve states.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If desk entries had logged valve states, U-A/U-B might have known about a change affecting H-R.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; the limitation of record-keeping is explicitly stated in IA-S01.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The absence of field-operation logging is documented."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-lzsmwx",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "The area directory does not establish valve positions or pressure availability at any given time, meaning U-A/U-B could not rely on it for real-time configuration.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the directory had established valve states, U-A/U-B could have verified H-R configuration before work.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a documented limitation of IA-D01.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The document explicitly disclaims real-time state information."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-2ovw8p",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "The point register maps signals but does not establish the physical state of distribution valves, leaving U-A/U-B without direct evidence of valve positions.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the point register established valve states, U-A/U-B could have confirmed H-R configuration.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a documented limitation of IA-P02.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The document explicitly disclaims physical state information."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1hmiwux",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "Crew U-A/U-B held current operating qualifications at shift start, but there is no evidence they received a recent change briefing or saw the specific configuration drawing used.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If U-A/U-B had received a change briefing, they might have known about recent modifications affecting H-R.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; absence of evidence for briefing is documented in IA-S03.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The lack of briefing/drawing visibility is explicitly noted."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-7cbf4",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "The daily work briefing topic line read '1SC dryer work and RHOB service coordination' but contained no valve-by-valve content, limiting U-A/U-B's situational awareness.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If the briefing had included valve-by-valve content, U-A/U-B might have known about H-R configuration.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; this is a documented limitation of IA-S03.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The absence of detailed content in the briefing is explicitly stated."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-u3hp7x",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "There is no evidence crew received a recent change briefing or saw the specific configuration drawing used, creating an information gap for U-A/U-B.",
      "status": "unknown",
      "sourceIds": [
        "7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If U-A/U-B had seen the configuration drawing, they might have known about H-R changes.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; absence of evidence for briefing/drawing visibility is documented in IA-S03.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The lack of evidence for recent change briefing or drawing visibility is explicitly noted."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-1rww984",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "No documented confirmation of understanding regarding root cause assessment or response steps is present, indicating a gap in procedural adherence for U-A/U-B.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If confirmation of understanding had been documented, U-A/U-B might have followed proper response steps.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; absence of documentation is explicitly stated in IA-S01.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The lack of documented confirmation is explicitly noted."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-2jmrrk",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "Maintenance acceptance signature was not yet signed at notification time, meaning the work boundary had not been formally released to U-A/U-B.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If maintenance acceptance had been signed, U-A/U-B might have known the work boundary was released.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; absence of signature is explicitly stated in IA-S02.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The lack of signature at notification time is explicitly noted."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-16kxawb",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "No line opening was authorized at the time of interruption, meaning U-A/U-B were not permitted to isolate or modify lines.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "24ec1587-92e9-4320-82c2-30368d834f1d#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If a line opening had been authorized, U-A/U-B might have taken corrective action.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; absence of authorization is explicitly stated in IA-S01.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The lack of authorization at interruption time is explicitly noted."
    },
    {
      "fromKey": "n-g659zd",
      "toKey": "n-t9cpzc",
      "type": "supported-by",
      "rationale": "Work folder WO-527-E was blank at issue time, meaning U-A/U-B lacked documented procedures or checklists for the task.",
      "status": "supported",
      "sourceIds": [
        "eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1"
      ],
      "claimIds": [],
      "counterfactual": "If WO-527-E had been completed, U-A/U-B might have followed documented procedures.",
      "competingExplanation": "None; blank work folder is explicitly stated in IA-S02.",
      "evidenceGap": "No gap. The lack of content in the work folder at issue time is explicitly noted."
    }
  ],"decision":{"summary":"The focal event (air-low indication) was preceded by a combination of supported conditions: stable upstream pressure, qualified personnel without recent change briefing or drawing visibility, incomplete documentation (blank work folder), and absence of line-opening authorization. These factors collectively created an information gap that prevented U-A/U-B from anticipating the interruption.","evidenceUsed":["b678a928-a8d2-472d-bc03-2e1a3dc411e6#1","fcd254db-75b3-4a9d-abec-44c5b6a9b34e#1","da0260c0-7d49-43e8-b074-da2a14c7d59c#1","eaee59fe-70f4-4876-a21d-780814412078#1","IA-S01_shift_and_notification_log.md"],"unknowns":["Whether U-A/U-B received a recent change briefing or saw the specific configuration drawing used.","The exact point of interruption (source, distribution system, or receiving equipment)."],"alternatives":["Upstream pressure drop vs. localized valve failure: Upstream stability supports localized issue but does not rule out upstream source failure without further evidence."],"confidence":0.85},"evidenceRequests":[
    "requestId-1","id\":\"7e69d300-c57e-40a8-bb37-35a61073ff33#2\",\"kind\":\"source-passage\",\"instruction\":\"Request the full text of IA-S03 to verify whether any mention exists of a change briefing or configuration drawing review for U-A/U-B.","status\":\"pending","rationale\":\"To determine if U-A/U-B received a recent change briefing, which could explain their lack of awareness about H-R changes."
  ]}
